every_group.description: True when the question asks for a value for each member of the grouping (each department, every provider), so members with none should appear with 0.

exposed_columns.description: Every catalog column whose values the answer would show: the column the answer is broken down by (the grouping) and any column the question asks to list per record. Fill it even when the question cannot be answered. Not columns used only in a condition, a measure or a join. Empty for a single total.

anyOf.description: The dimension the answer is broken down by, or null for a single value per source.

read_columns.description: Every catalog column the answer reads: the exposed columns plus each column measured, counted per entity, used in a condition or used as a join key. Fill it even when the question cannot be answered, with the columns the question refers to. Empty only when no catalog column relates to the question.
